A CRD is `apiextensions.k8s.io/v1 CustomResourceDefinition`. The `metadata.name` must be `<plural>.<group>` — so `environments.platform.dojo`. Generate a skeleton with the Kubernetes docs or copy from `kubectl get crd <any-existing-crd> -o yaml`.

The schema goes under `spec.versions[0].schema.openAPIV3Schema`. You need `spec.tier` to be a `type: string` with an `enum` list. Mark `tier` as required inside `spec`'s `required` array. After applying, run `kubectl wait --for=condition=Established crd/environments.platform.dojo --timeout=30s` before creating a CR.

Creating the CR: `apiVersion: platform.dojo/v1alpha1`, `kind: Environment`, `metadata.namespace: dojo-crd2`, `spec.tier: dev` (or stage/prod). The verifier reads `.spec.tier` with jsonpath and checks it's in the allowed set.
